 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Lifestyle Lifestyle Miss Universe PH 2024 candidate Matea Mahal Smith wins Miss Jamaica World 2026 
 By GMA News Published November 3, 2026 2:07pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Matea Mahal Smith Former Miss Universe Philippines 2024 candidate Matea Mahal Smith has been crowned Miss Jamaica World 2026.
 On Instagram, Matea expressed her gratitude following her coronation, saying she was still taking in the moment.
 “Jamaica, it is an honour to wear your name. There is so much ahead, and I’m ready to give it my all,” Matea wrote.
 She also thanked her family, coaches, supporters, and the Miss Jamaica World Organization for their support throughout the competition.
 “To the women I shared this journey with, thank you for the laughter, encouragement, and memories we made together. I’m grateful our paths brought us here,” she said.
 Matea previously represented the Filipino community in Florida at the Miss Universe Philippines 2024 pageant. Chelsea Manalo won the competition.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Matea Mahal (@matea.mahal) 
 —Carby Rose Basina/JCB, GMA News
